rule: Leading YYYY/YYYY is interpreted as manufacturing_year/registration_year for a single vehicle; source-group alternatives are collapsed.
year_assumption: The first year is treated as confirmed manufacturing year, and the second as registration year solely within this simulation. No vehicle-specific evidence required.
reference_method: Model, make and main trim come from original descriptions; Malaysian used-car advertisements serve as external naming and year-format examples. Any included market links are contextual, not claimed to identify the same physical vehicle.

specifications_enrichment.scope: specifications.seats and specifications.fuel_consumption for 97 simulated vehicles
specifications_enrichment.fuel_consumption_unit: L/100 km (litres per 100 kilometres; lower number = more efficient)
specifications_enrichment.fuel_consumption_definition: manufacturer/technical-catalogue combined-cycle number or closest available period-appropriate model estimate, NOT real-world consumption
specifications_enrichment.comparison_warning: NEDC, JC08, WLTC, ADR, US EPA and representative values are not directly comparable across test cycles.
specifications_enrichment.assumption_policy: If original description lacks seat layout, choose a plausible factory layout for the specified model/trim; estimate if exact homologation unavailable. Each record includes status/source/notes.

quality_legend.direct: Period-relevant published specifications for the stated engine/trim (or exact platform/drivetrain).
quality_legend.closely_matched: Related market/year or near-equivalent factory drivetrain and layout; figures are representative.
quality_legend.simulation_default: Indicative value assigned using related factory specification and model knowledge; exact figure not independently confirmed.
